title: Machine Translation Meta Evaluation through Translation Accuracy Challenge Sets
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating machine translation metrics for accuracy errors and their sensitivity to linguistic phenomena. While it references works discussing societal impacts of MT errors (e.g., in medical/legal domains) and gender bias, its own methodology and benchmarking framework (ACES) do not directly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as core aspects of MT system or metric performance. Gender bias is covered under 'is_bias_related'.
